items.name: Warm Apple Almond Oat Porridge
steps: Rinse or dry-toast the rolled oats as appropriate.
Combine it with the water and simmer until the grain begins to soften.
Add the unsweetened almond milk and diced apple, chopped almonds; continue cooking gently.
Stir in the cinnamon and sweetener when the porridge is tender and creamy.
Rest for two minutes and serve warm.
items.guidance: Warm Apple Almond Oat Porridge is cooked and served warm, with fruit cooked into the grain when included. Vata: serve warm, cook until tender, and add a little ghee if the dish feels dry. Pitta: moderate chilies and sharp sourness, favoring coriander or fennel. Kapha: keep the portion light, reduce added fat, and favor ginger or black pepper.
